content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: step1: sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). step2: amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide). step3: Doebner modification to create the α,β-unsaturated acid (C=C) from aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid.

Thus retrosynthesis: target -> break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) and an aniline (Ar-NH2). The sulfonyl chloride derived from sulfonyl chloride of the second aromatic ring (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride). So precursor1: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph-CH3) and aniline (p-toluidine?) Actually the sulfonamide attaches to first aromatic ring (p-methyl phenyl) via NH linking to sulfonyl group attached to second aromatic ring (p-methyl phenyl). So disconnection: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) where Ar is the second phenyl with the side chain (the unsaturated amide). And the amine is the first phenyl with methyl (p-toluidine). So step1: sulfonamide formation.

Step2: amide formation: break C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (the unsaturated acid) and aniline (aniline attached to phenyl). The amide is between the unsaturated acid and an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N is an aniline). Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to aniline (aniline is c3ccccc3N). So break to give the acid (C=O)O-? The acid is the α,β-unsaturated acid attached to phenyl ring (the same phenyl as the aniline? Wait structure: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the unsaturated chain attached to second phenyl ring (the sulfonyl phenyl). The amide attaches to an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So the amide carbonyl is attached to the unsaturated chain and to an aniline nitrogen. So disconnection yields: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step2: amide coupling.

Step3: Doebner modification: produce the α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde (aryl-CHO) and malonic acid. The aldehyde is the same phenyl ring (c3ccccc3) with aldehyde at para? Actually the unsaturated acid attaches to phenyl ring at position where aldehyde would be. So we need aromatic aldehyde (c3ccccc3C=O) and malonic acid to give α,β-unsaturated acid (aryl-CH=CH-COOH). So step3: Doebner.

Thus we need to find templates for each step. We have template for sulfonamide formation (template_id 733 etc). For amide formation we need a template that couples carboxylic acid to amine. Search for amide formation template. Let's search for functional_groups_formed: amide, broken: carboxylic acid? but need correct functional group names: "carboxylic acid" is not allowed; we have "aliphatic carboxylic acid" or "aromatic carboxylic acid". The amide formation breaks a carboxylic acid (aliphatic or aromatic) and forms amide. So we can search with broken: ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"] and formed: ["amide"].
